Definition: of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) other or different:--altered, else, next (day), one, (an-)other, some, strange.
BiblicalUsage: I take héteros to mean another, other, different, nothing more and nothing less. It occurs 92 times, and Matthew and Mark show it doing ordinary work in ordinary sentences. The Bible uses plain words plainly, and this is one of them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that héteros matters because another gospel is no gospel at all. My position is that Scripture does not hide its meaning from honest readers.
RelatedEvents: The Road to Emmaus; The Crucifixion
